values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753672 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a concrete boat ramp, a vault toilet and primitive campsites; no drinking water listed. ADA accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753672 (Facilities: 'Ramp (Concrete)', 'Toilet (Vault)', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (94 acres, ~3,370 ft) on the Missouri River with designated primitive camping. Directions (FWP): 7 miles south of Cascade, take Hardy Creek Exit 247 off I-15, then 1.75 miles north on Old US Highway 91. FWP: '2 picnic tables by large pond.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, vault toilet (derived -> manual), concrete ramp, primitive campsites. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: trailer length (none published; no review from the last 3 years giving a 23-ft+ rig found), stay limit (this page lists none), site count, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees.
